title: The inventory reads answer a BARE array, not the data/version envelope, and two of them take their paging in a POST body

source.note: The vendor's own inconsistency, reproduced rather than smoothed over. ListInventoryRecords and ListInventoryLevels are POSTs whose 200 is declared as {"type": "array", "items": Inventory / InventoryLevel} -- no `data` wrapper and no `version` pair, unlike every other list on this API -- and their query travels in the request body under names of their own (`size`, `offset`) rather than as page_size/after query parameters. GET /stock_adjustments, on the same tag, DOES answer the envelope (StockAdjustmentCollection). A consumer that wrote one list walker for this API discovers that here.

steps.name: the inventory records are a bare array
